'''Chapter 348''' is titled "Fighting Power".

==Cover Page==
[[Gedatsu's Accidental Blue-Sea Life]], Conclusion: "Come On Down To Ukkari Hot-Spring Island".

Too late to back out now: like it or not, [[Gedatsu]] has become co-proprietor of a beloved tourist spot on the [[Blue Sea]].

==Short Summary==
[[Nico Robin]] begins to leave while the [[Straw Hat Pirates]] try to get past [[CP9]] to stop her.

==Long Summary==
[[CP9]] explains that fire will rise from the first floor and that they plan to frame the [[Straw Hat Pirates]] for the chaos. The Straw Hats, angered by this, all prepare to attack. [[Nico Robin|Robin]] turns to leave while the Straw Hats and [[Iceburg]] all try to stop her. [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] charges towards her but is blocked by [[Blueno]], who easily dodges all of Luffy's attacks using '''Kamie''' and '''Soru'''. Using '''Geppo''', Blueno appears to float in the air while [[Kalifa]] and [[Kaku]] attack using '''Rankyaku''', sending Luffy flying back and cutting through the wall.

[[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] attacks Kaku and questions his inspection of the [[Going Merry]], however Kaku reveals that even though he was incognito, he was serious about the ship's condition. The two continue to fight each other as Luffy notices Robin has finally reached the window. In a last-minute attempt to stop her, Luffy makes a start towards the window while Zoro is defeated by Kaku using '''Shigan'''. Luffy is caught and thrown against a wall by [[Rob Lucci|Lucci]] as Robin escapes through the window.

Rob Lucci then explains that CP9 have trained since they were young and are always sent out to extreme missions. He states that they have a huge difference in combat power compared to the Straw Hats. Kalifa interrupts and announces that it is almost time for the fire to start as Rob Lucci states he has something interesting for them. Lucci then begins to transform into an unknown creature, shocking everyone there.

==Quick Reference==

===Chapter Notes===
*The techniques of the [[Six Powers]] are briefly explained.
**'''Tekkai''' allows the user's body to be reinforced by steel, hardening their defense.
**'''Shigan''' allows the user to pierce flesh with their finger.
**'''Geppo''' allows the user to achieve a form of flight by kicking the air.
**'''Kamie''' allows the user to effortlessly dodge attacks, while their body resembles a piece of paper.
**'''Soru''' allows the user to dodge anything at an extreme speed.
**'''Rankyaku''' allows the user to kick the air to create a blade-like cutting attack.
*Even though [[Kaku]] was pretending to be a shipwright, his inspection of the [[Going Merry]] was not a lie, as it is still in no condition to sail.
*As [[Nico Robin|Robin]] leaves, she tells the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] they will never meet again.
*It is almost time for the fire about to incinerate [[Galley-La Headquarters]] to erupt.
*[[Rob Lucci|Lucci]] begins to transform into a beast-like form.
